data.task_title: Load and Analyze Pipeline Execution Data

features.title: Provide Optimization Recommendations
features.description: Develop a feature to offer recommendations for optimizing pipeline performance based on analyzed data.
acceptance_criteria: System generates recommendations based on performance data
Recommendations are prioritized by potential impact
Users receive notifications of new recommendations

features.title: Analyze Pipeline Execution Metrics
features.description: Create a module to analyze pipeline execution data and calculate key performance metrics.
acceptance_criteria: System calculates metrics such as execution time and success rate
Metrics are updated in real-time as new data is loaded
Users can view detailed metric reports

features.title: Load Pipeline Execution Data
features.description: Develop functionality to load pipeline execution data into the system for analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Data can be imported from multiple sources
Data import process is logged for auditing
System handles data import errors gracefully

features.title: Visualize Pipeline Performance
features.description: Implement visualizations for pipeline performance metrics to provide insights.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view charts and graphs of performance metrics
System supports exporting visualizations for reporting
